_comment: MCP configuration for FrameForge — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, opencode, and IBM Bob.

_modes.stdio: ZERO-PORT STDIO: Recommended for Cursor & Claude Code. Spawns node process directly via stdin/stdout.
_modes.local: HTTP SERVER: Runs local server on port 3210. Good for web apps or multi-client sharing.
_modes.remote: CLOUDFLARE REMOTE MCP: Connects via edge URL. Saves ~80% prompt context tokens in your IDE.

_paths.agent-first: Path 1 — your IDE writes scenes, FrameForge renders with code-driven animations & user media. Only TTS needed. No LLM key.
_paths.auto-research: Path 2 — FrameForge researches and scripts autonomously. Requires PROVIDER_LLM + its key.

frameforge._comment: RECOMMENDED — Path 1 agent-first (no LLM key). Add PROVIDER_LLM + key only for research_topic/write_script/queue_full_pipeline.

frameforge-http._comment: LOCAL HTTP on port 3210 — same Path 1 defaults. Add LLM vars only for auto-research path.

frameforge-remote._comment: REMOTE EDGE: Connects via Cloudflare Worker. Deploy cloudflare-mcp/ to enable.
